title.narrative: National Phase-out of Methyl Bromide in Mexico - Terminal Project

description.narrative: The Government of Mexico has committed to achieving the complete phase-out of MB by the end of 2012. Additional activities will be i ntroduced in soil fumigation including: procurement of additional equipment and farm material to be distributed among strawberry, berry, and tomato producers; continued provision of technical assistance to consolidate the technology transfer already done, and training for growers as well as continued monitoring of MB users and of the performance of MB alternatives. The technologies to be introduced are substrate (coco fibre) in strawberries, grafting in tomatoes, and bio fumigation in addition to alternative chemicals in berries.
